description: Financial ratios Valuein precomputes from each company's SEC filings. A bare call returns the 2 most recent periods and every category except growth and rank (both large); pass `categories` (e.g. ["growth","rank"]) to get them and `limit` (up to 20) for more periods. Served categories: profitability (margins, ROE, ROA, ROIC), liquidity (current ratio, quick ratio), leverage (D/E, interest coverage, net debt/EBITDA), efficiency (asset turnover, inventory days), per_share (EPS, BVPS, FCF/share), owner_earnings (Buffett FCF, owner yield), valuation (graham_number, ncav_per_share; no price-based multiple is published), and the pipeline-emitted forensic, growth, and rank (cross-sectional *_sector_pctile) categories. NOT every category exists for every ticker — omit `categories` to get whatever this ticker has, or read `available_categories` on the DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_PERIOD error a missing category returns. valuation is the pair of price-free reference points precomputed at each fiscal period end from SEC filings data. Includes TTM rows alongside annual; each row's `is_calendar_aligned` is TRUE only when period_end sits on the fiscal-year boundary (±7 days) — filter to TRUE when joining ratios to fact-table fundamentals on (entity, fiscal_year). For historical cuts use `as_of_date` (PIT by accepted_at when present, else by period_end — see the param). For the profitability, leverage and cash-flow summary with per-figure provenance use `get_valuation_metrics`; for intrinsic value use `compute_dcf`. Each ratio is a `{value, unit, category, reason}` entry with a response-level `lineage` (DerivedLineage) pointing to `get_company_fundamentals` / `verify_fact_lineage` for filing-level provenance; a null value carries a `reason` (e.g. INPUT_MISSING) so missing is never a real zero. An FY ratio also carries a `derived_id`: cite it like a fact_id (verify_facts re-reads the row). On fiscal-year rows net_debt (total_debt − (cash + short-term investments), the compute_dcf definition), fcf_margin, debt_to_equity (total_debt / equity) and the *_cagr_Ny ratios are recomputed from the annual facts (`basis: recomputed_from_facts`) so every tool agrees; those carry a formula-form `derived_id` over the input facts when a registered formula reproduces the figure (net_debt carries none); a CAGR over a zero or negative base is null with a reason. Available on all plans.

as_of_date.description: Historical cutoff (canonical cross-tool date param). PIT by SEC accepted_at when the ratio data carries it (latest value knowable on/before the date, zero look-ahead, _meta.pit_safe=true), else by ratio.period_end (pit_safe=false). For guaranteed accepted_at PIT use get_company_fundamentals.

categories.description: Ratio categories to include (see the enum). Omit to return every category this ticker has except growth and rank, which are returned only when named here. `valuation` (graham_number, ncav_per_share) are precomputed at each fiscal period end. Availability is per-ticker (the envelope lists this ticker's available_categories).

fiscal_period.description: Filter to a specific fiscal period type. Use 'TTM' for trailing twelve months. Omit to return both annual (FY) and TTM rows.

limit.description: Number of distinct period_end dates to return (1–20). Defaults to 2. Within each period, all matching ratio_names are included.

period_end_before.description: Alias of as_of_date (as_of_date preferred — the canonical name). Returns ratios with period_end on or before this date.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, MSFT — or a CIK (SEC identifier), e.g. '0000320193'.

name: get_financial_ratios

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

basis.description: Present when the pipeline value was replaced by the Worker's own computation from the annual facts (net_debt, fcf_margin, debt_to_equity, *_cagr_Ny), so every tool quotes one definition. `detail` states it.

derived_id.description: Citation id of this ratio (drv1:<cik>:pipeline:ratio.<name>@1:period_end=...): cite it like a fact_id; verify_facts re-reads the ratio row and reproduces `display`. Absent when the figure cannot be re-read as quoted (TTM or quarterly rows, a server-corrected sign).

display.description: The ratio rendered exactly as it should be quoted (31.20%, 1.45x, $6.11). QUOTE THIS VERBATIM instead of converting `value` yourself.

lineage.description: Provenance for pipeline-derived values (ratio.parquet / factor_scores.parquet): source table + pipeline computed_at, plus a pointer to the tools that return filing-level lineage. NOT point-in-time (recomputed on each pipeline run).

title: Financial Ratios
